forms.name: Petrified Blade
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Great
Sword for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Blade
forms.text:
The Petrified Blade's final
form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Defender
forms.text:
A Great Sword that can also
serve as a shield. Stresses
defensive strength.

forms.name: Sentinel
forms.text:
The Defender's final form.
True to its name, Defense is
easily what it does best.

forms.name: Bastion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Defender</COL>.

forms.name: Barbaroi Blade
forms.text:
A great blade housing a
raging inferno. The lightest
swing ignites an epic blaze.

forms.name: Crimson Goat
forms.text:
The Barbaroi Blade's final
form. Those seared by its
crimson blade turn to ash.

forms.name: Blood Baph
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Barbaroi Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Storm
forms.text:
A weapon of indelible strength
and character. Its might cannot
be overstated.

forms.name: Despot's Blackstorm
forms.text:
Become a true lord of thunder
with the final form of
the Usurper's Storm.

forms.name: Oppressor's Forger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Storm</COL>.

forms.name: Type 41 Wyvernator
forms.text:
A special blade designed to kill
flying wyverns. A single swing puts
man and beast on equal footing.

forms.name: Remalgalypse
forms.text:
To wield the Type 41
Wyvernator's final form is to
abandon one's humanity.

forms.name: Remalgagorgon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Type 41 Wyvernator</COL>.

forms.name: Khezu Shock Sword
forms.text:
A sword clad in elemental
material, which electrifies
the blade.

forms.name: Khezu Shock Blade
forms.text:
The Khezu Shock Sword's final
form. Each swing bathes the
land in deadly electricity.

forms.name: Khezu Shock Full
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Khezu Shock Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Halberd
forms.text:
Low on Sharpness but high on
attack, this Great Sword has
been esteemed for eons.

forms.name: Judgment
forms.text:
The Halberd's final form.
Delivers swift judgment with
each and every swing.

forms.name: Eternal Torment
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Halberd</COL>.

forms.name: Igneous Blade
forms.text:
A fiery sword infused with the
fury of the earth. One swing can
even part rivers of lava.

forms.name: Igneous Sword
forms.text:
The Igneous Blade's final
form can swiftly transform
barren land into a sea of lava.

forms.name: Igneous Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Igneous Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Decider
forms.text:
Heavy Great Sword of high
quality steel. Symbol of an
ancient judge's authority.

forms.name: Punisher
forms.text:
The Decider's final form.
A massive blade normally used
solely for executions.

forms.name: Martyr
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Decider</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Blade
forms.text:
A Great Sword forged from an
ebon fossil. Absorbs light
and shines even brighter.

forms.name: Luminous Jurasta
forms.text:
The Obsidian Blade's final
form. Yesterday's fossil is
today's monster hunter.

forms.name: Ethereal Jurasta
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Sword
forms.text:
A Great Sword that's seen
extended use for ages.
Good for beginners, too.

forms.name: Carbalite Sword
forms.text:
The Iron Sword's final
form. Traditional looks belie
its impressive strength.

forms.name: Eltalite Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Santoku Reaver
forms.text:
A blade made of sharpened
Tetsucabra shell. The whorls
on the blade affect value.

forms.name: Funayuki Reaver
forms.text:
The Santoku Reaver's final
form. Its blade makes the
wielder look grimly savage.

forms.name: Kaeruzaki Reaver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Santoku Reaver</COL>.

forms.name: Toad Bereaver
forms.text:
Almost too strange-looking
to be called a Great Sword.
This weapon REALLY cooks.

forms.name: Millstone Bereaver
forms.text:
The Toad Bereaver's final
form minces through prey
like no kitchen knife can.

forms.name: Visceral Bereaver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Toad Bereaver</COL>.

forms.name: Buster Sword
forms.text:
A steel Great Sword that's
perfect for beginners and
admired for its handling.

forms.name: Buster Blade
forms.text:
The Buster Sword's final
form. Pure, quality steel
heightens its Attack.

forms.name: Buster Falx
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Buster Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Brazenwall
forms.text:
A shining gold blade. Its
super-hard edge makes it
versatile but hard to wield.

forms.name: Crimsonwall
forms.text:
Not even blood can dull the
brilliant luster on the
Brazenwall's final form.

forms.name: Crimsonwall Zenith
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Brazenwall</COL>.

forms.name: Skraga
forms.text:
A Great Sword resembling the
Najarala. Its paralyzing
poison does in many monsters.

forms.name: Grand Skraga
forms.text:
Once struck by the paralyzing
poison on the Skraga's final
form, only death remains.

forms.name: Medjed Skraga
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skraga</COL>.

forms.name: Chrome Razor
forms.text:
A strong, razor-sharp edge
(hence the name). This blade
hides a secret poison.

forms.name: Chrome Quietus
forms.text:
The Chrome Razor's final
form. Stocked with poison
extracted from dragons.

forms.name: Chrome Hell
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chrome Razor</COL>.

forms.name: Carapace Sword
forms.text:
A blade shaped like a
Barroth's head; it packs
nearly as much punch.

forms.name: Carapace Blade
forms.text:
The Carapace Sword's final form.
To see one of its earth-gouging
attacks is to tremble with fear.

forms.name: Barroth Smasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Carapace Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Ravager Blade
forms.text:
A fearsome steel sword with
giant, talon-like spikes that
protrude from its blade.

forms.name: Raging Blade
forms.text:
The Ravager Blade's final
form, tough and sharp as
it'll ever be.

forms.name: Wrathful Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ravager Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Blade
forms.text:
A vastly remodeled Ravager
Blade made with Nargacuga
parts for improved strength.

forms.name: Dark of Night
forms.text:
The Hidden Blade's final
form. Nobody comes away
alive after seeing it.

forms.name: Avidya Great Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Tactical Blade
forms.text:
A Ravager Blade family sword
with not only high Attack,
but lots of Sharpness, too.

forms.name: Strategic Blade
forms.text:
The Tactical Blade's final
form. Famously decided wars
with but a lone swing.

forms.name: Mastermind Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tactical Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Lacerator Blade
forms.text:
A Ravager Blade family sword
with high Sharpness for
those obsessed with slicing.

forms.name: Devastator Blade
forms.text:
The Lacerator Blade's final
form. There's nothing to fear
with this in your arsenal.

forms.name: Exemplar Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lacerator Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Lagiacrus Blade
forms.text:
An electric blade made using
Lagiacrus materials. Danger:
high voltage!

forms.name: High Lagia Blade
forms.text:
The Lagiacrus Blade's final
form is fury incarnate, its
thunder commanding awe.

forms.name: Exlagia Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagiacrus Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Plesioth Watercutter
forms.text:
An impressive Great Sword with
strong elemental properties. Water
shoots from the fin when swung.

forms.name: Plesioth Aquablade
forms.text:
The Plesioth Watercutter's
final form. Like waterfalls,
it splashes and hits hard.

forms.name: Plesioth Sea-Reaver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plesioth Watercutter</COL>.

forms.name: Plesioth Wave Sword
forms.text:
This high-maintenance top-
quality piece is many times
stronger than a water beam.

forms.name: Plesioth Wave Blade
forms.text:
Few can tame the mighty
waves of the Plesioth Wave
Sword's final form.

forms.name: Plesioth Wave Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Plesioth Wave Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Lagia Lightning
forms.text:
A blue Great Sword as mighty
as a real Lagiacrus. The
thorns signify its anger.

forms.name: Lagia Wildfire
forms.text:
The Lagia Lightning's final
form. The terror of the sea
returns as a Great Sword.

forms.name: Lagia Supreme Thunder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagia Lightning</COL>.

forms.name: Clero Blade
forms.text:
Made from a Great Maccao.
Handles like a dream, as light
as a feather on the wind.

forms.name: Clero Regiska
forms.text:
The Clero Blade's final form.
Has zero wind resistance and can
unleash countless attacks with ease.

forms.name: Preacher Regiska
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Clero Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Cleaver
forms.text:
A Great Sword made of monster
bones. Emphasizes destructive
power above all else.

forms.name: Bone Slasher
forms.text:
The Bone Cleaver's final form
uses the finest bones to smash
targets into an even finer pulp.

forms.name: Bone Splitter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Cleaver</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth Bone Sword
forms.text:
A bone blade reinforced with
Ludroth parts. A good base
level for further upgrading.

forms.name: Ludroth Bone Blade
forms.text:
The Ludroth Bone Sword's
final form is made splendid
with its Ludroth spirit.

forms.name: Ludroth Beheader
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth Bone Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Snowclad
forms.text:
Cold though this sword might
be, the decorative bits
keep the wielder toasty.

forms.name: Lagombi Charlotte
forms.text:
The Snowclad's final form
radiates with the majesty
of the snow-driven Lagombi.

forms.name: Lagombi Decider
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Snowclad</COL>.

forms.name: Cataclysm Sword
forms.text:
A blade of absorbent sponge.
Its pressurized water can
break through tough shells.

forms.name: Cataclysm Blade
forms.text:
The Cataclysm Sword's final
form. The water inside it
leaves behind rainbows.

forms.name: Aquatic Cataclysm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cataclysm Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Icicle Fang
Paladire
forms.text:
The Icicle Fang's final form.
One strike can freeze the deepest
ocean -- and shatter it.

forms.name: Blizzard Biter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Icicle Fang</COL>.

forms.name: Red Stripe
forms.text:
Combines bone with super
strong shell material,
allowing for high Defense.

forms.name: Akatsume
forms.text:
The Red Stripe's final form
is a Great Sword made from
handpicked Hermitaur shells.

forms.name: Red Kagizume
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Red Stripe</COL>.

forms.name: Red Pincer
forms.text:
A Great Sword made from a
giant pincer. Its blade rips
off scales and slices flesh.

forms.name: Great Pincer
forms.text:
The Red Pincer's final
form. Its red hue amplifies
its overall viciousness.

forms.name: Gargantuan Pincer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Red Pincer</COL>.

forms.name: Ceanataur Blade
forms.text:
Sharp Great Sword made from
a blue shell. Only the finest
materials are used in its blade.

forms.name: Killer's Scythe
forms.text:
The Ceanataur Blade's final
form has a fine blade for
the finest Sharpness around.

forms.name: Ceanataur Scythe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ceanataur Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Jawblade
forms.text:
A traditional bone Great
Sword whose name evokes
the gnawing of monster flesh.

forms.name: Giant Jawblade
forms.text:
The Jawblade's final form
is still powerful, but now
it's all the more sharp, too.

forms.name: Massive Jawblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Jawblade</COL>.

forms.name: Golem Blade
forms.text:
A Great Sword formed from a
giant bone. Its powerful,
hefty blade is deadly.

forms.name: Blade of Talos
forms.text:
The Golem Blade's final form.
Its mythological ties to
giants accents its power.

forms.name: Blade of Tartarus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Golem Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Valkyrie Blade
forms.text:
A blade born of bone and Rathian
parts. Upgradable into one of
a pair of regal Great Swords.

forms.name: Sieglinde
forms.text:
The Valkyrie Blade's final
form. Beautiful but deadly,
thanks to its poison.

forms.name: High Sieglinde
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Valkyrie Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Spartacus Blade
forms.text:
The crimson blade of a brave
king. He who uses it justly
will win a hundred battles.

forms.name: Siegmund
forms.text:
Those lacking courage can't
even touch the Spartacus
Blade's final form.

forms.name: High Siegmund
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spartacus Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Reddnaught
forms.text:
A famous weapon once wielded
by a fearless hero. It loathes
cowardice, but aids courage.

forms.name: Super Reddnaught
forms.text:
The Reddnaught's final form.
It will help the courageous along
the path of the hero.

forms.name: Aurio
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Reddnaught</COL>.

forms.name: Tiger Jawblade
forms.text:
Modeled on a large Tigrex
fang. One swipe can rip the
target to shreds.

forms.name: Tigrex Great Sword
forms.text:
The Tiger Jawblade's final
form. Anyone with this has
truly conquered the world.

forms.name: Tigrex Supreme Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tiger Jawblade</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Blade
forms.text:
A blade housing the power of
a Brachydios. Its explosive
slime can shatter solid rock.

forms.name: Brach Attack
forms.text:
The Dios Blade's final form.
A strong sword affixed with
even stronger explosives.

forms.name: Brach Thunder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Sword
forms.text:
An explosive blade that cleaves
foes in twain and blasts them to
bits, leaving only scattered parts.

forms.name: Myxo Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Sword's final
form. Upgraded to the point
of reckless power.

forms.name: Myxo Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Blade
forms.text:
A Great Sword with tremendous,
volatile power that leaves no
trace of victims in its wake.

forms.name: Lightbreak Ash
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Blade's final form.
Its explosive power can destroy the
world if improperly used.

forms.name: Lightbreak Ember
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Executioner
forms.text:
A sword made of bone with an
enormous head. More likely to
smash a skull than cut it off.

forms.name: Salvationblade
forms.text:
Nobody questions your justice
when faced with the final
form of the Executioner.

forms.name: Ascendance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Executioner</COL>.

forms.name: Thrash Sword
forms.text:
A rounded blade that elicits
gasps for its beauty, screams
when its twin blades sing.

forms.name: Thrash Cutlass
forms.text:
The double curved blades of the
Thrash Sword's final form are
designed for cleaving prey in twain.

forms.name: Thrash Schneider
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thrash Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Immane Blade
forms.text:
A blade that leverages the
Nerscylla's unique materials
to exceed Forge limits.

forms.name: Immolator Blade
forms.text:
The Immane Blade's final form.
Its chops possess a sharpness
that tears targets asunder.

forms.name: Shadow Nercleave
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Immane Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Scylla Blade
forms.text:
An augmented, advanced blade
so dreadfully sharp that it
can split any prey in two.

forms.name: Scylla Razor
forms.text:
The Scylla Blade's final form
makes use of the original's dreadful
sharpness and takes it even further.

forms.name: Scylla Shear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scylla Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Thrash Blade
forms.text:
A blade whose eyes are said to
open when drawn. Lovelier AND
wieldier than its predecessor.

forms.name: Thrashgash Blade
forms.text:
The Thrash Blade's final
form is decorative enough
for formal occasions.

forms.name: Jala Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thrash Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern Jawblade
forms.text:
A bone blade forged from claws
and fangs, capable of tearing
through a wyvern's carapace.

forms.name: Wyvern Gnasher
forms.text:
The Wyvern Jawblade's final
form. Forged of Wyvern bone,
muncher of Wyvern shells.

forms.name: Wyvern Chomper
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern Jawblade</COL>.

forms.name: Quarrel Hornsword
forms.text:
A wild-looking, considerably
powerful blade crafted from
Diablos horns.

forms.name: Feud Hornsword
forms.text:
The Quarrel Hornsword's final form.
Whatever calls forth its true power
must be terrible indeed.

forms.name: Vendetta Hornsword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Quarrel Hornsword</COL>.

forms.name: Red Wing
forms.text:
A blade inspired by Rathalos
wings. Incendiaries turn its
slashes to arcs of flame.

forms.name: Rathalos Firesword
forms.text:
The Red Wing's final form.
Each slash shoots flames
that incinerate all.

forms.name: Rathalos Flamesword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Red Wing</COL>.

forms.name: Rathalos Gleamsword
forms.text:
A luminous blade said to hold
a silver flame from the heavens.
Its fire burns foes to cinders.

forms.name: Rathlord Gleamsword
forms.text:
The Rathalos Gleamsword's
final form gives all the
world a much-needed razing.

forms.name: Rathlord Sunsword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rathalos Gleamsword</COL>.

forms.name: Cheda Blade
forms.text:
A blade like a Seregios horn.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Impudent Cheda
forms.text:
The Cheda Blade's final
form gleams with its
inexhaustible Sharpness.

forms.name: Barefaced Cheda
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cheda Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Cleaver
forms.text:
A blade made of a Seregios horn.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Rogue Sedition
forms.text:
The Seditious Cleaver's final
iteration. The icon of a world
sunken into chaos.

forms.name: Sedition Slicer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Cleaver</COL>.

forms.name: Azure Serpentblade
forms.text:
The evil version of a
Ravager Blade. Modeled
after a snake's head.

forms.name: Azure Fangblade
forms.text:
The Azure Serpentblade's
final form. Now with
added fangs for more bite.

forms.name: Azure Dreadfang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Azure Serpentblade</COL>.

forms.name: White Serpentblade
forms.text:
Beautiful Great Sword made
from white Giaprey scales.
Lined with gold fangs.

forms.name: Golden Serpentblade
forms.text:
The White Serpentblade's
final form. Its beauty is
matched by its deadliness.

forms.name: Adamant Serpentblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>White Serpentblade</COL>.

forms.name: Saffron Fangblade
forms.text:
A Velociprey Great Sword
strengthened with poisoned
Genprey materials.

forms.name: Saffron Serpentblade
forms.text:
The Saffron Fangblade's
final form has fangs
that beckon prey closer.

forms.name: Saffron Serpentroar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Saffron Fangblade</COL>.

forms.name: Fanged Serpentblade
forms.text:
A blade like a poison fang.
Its lifeless glare elicits
terror beyond words.

forms.name: Amaranth Fangblade
forms.text:
The Fanged Serpentblade's
final form. Its dark eyes
morbidly await new prey.

forms.name: Amaranth Battlefang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fanged Serpentblade</COL>.

forms.name: Deadly Serpentblade
forms.text:
A traditional blade made
from Remobra parts. Venom
drips from its scarlet fangs.

forms.name: Poison Serpentblade
forms.text:
The Deadly Serpentblade's
final form. The red fangs
make for an ill omen.

forms.name: Snakesmaw
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Deadly Serpentblade</COL>.

forms.name: Chicken Decapitator
forms.text:
Diligently crafted using
Kut-Ku parts to resemble
the beast's wing.

forms.name: Rooster Decapitator
forms.text:
The Chicken Decapitator's
final form has admirers
even within the art world.

forms.name: Capon Decapitator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chicken Decapitator</COL>.

forms.name: Sentoryu Raven
forms.text:
A black blade made from Yian
Garuga parts. Can slice up
anything that approaches it.

forms.name: Sentoryu Wolf
forms.text:
The Sentoryu Raven's final
form contains the soul of
the reclusive Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Sentoryu Crow
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sentoryu Raven</COL>.

forms.name: Sentoryu Bane
forms.text:
A bizarre blade used by the
Garuga King to finish his rival.
Deals merciless, crushing cuts.

forms.name: Garuga Engetsu
forms.text:
The Sentoryu Bane's final
form signals the arrival of
a new brand of insanity.

forms.name: Occult Engetsu
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sentoryu Bane</COL>.

forms.name: Nocturnal Falx
forms.text:
The wing-like form of this
Great Sword descends on
prey like a terrible raptor.

forms.name: Slumbering Duke
forms.text:
The Nocturnal Falx's final
form bewilders its victims
before slicing their hearts.

forms.name: Dormant Archduke
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nocturnal Falx</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Edge
forms.text:
A popular Great Sword used
around Yukumo Village that's
safe, sturdy, and reliable.

forms.name: Yukumo Blade
forms.text:
The Yukumo Edge's
final form. Symbolic of the
villagers' majestic spirit.

forms.name: Hot Spring Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Pure Edge
forms.text:
The Yukumo Edge's
true form. Easily breaks down
all the walls you like.

forms.name: Yukumo Cloudcutter
forms.text:
The Yukumo Pure Edge's
final form. Not even steel
beats this sword's hardness!

forms.name: Yukumo Quiescent Moon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Pure Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Larisaber
forms.text:
A wildly popular Great Sword
known for the slogan, "The
Larinoth's got your back."

forms.name: Long Larisaber
forms.text:
The Larisaber's final form.
Its adorable form factor is
making serious waves.

forms.name: Overlong Larisaber
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Larisaber</COL>.

forms.name: Vulcanis
forms.text:
A weapon whose shape naturally
emerged as it was crafted. Is it a
relic from an ancient memory?

forms.name: Vulcamagnon
forms.text:
The Vulcanis's final form.
Holds power enough to breathe
life into forgotten lands.

forms.name: Vulcatastrophe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vulcanis</COL>.

forms.name: Frozen Speartuna
forms.text:
A frozen Speartuna wielded as
a Great Sword. Proof that the
owner is the final fisher.

forms.name: Freezer Speartuna
forms.text:
The Frozen Speartuna's final
form. No longer just any
old Speartuna, far from it.

forms.name: Xiphias Gladius
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Frozen Speartuna</COL>.

forms.name: Wyvern's Perch
forms.text:
A wooden sword covered in sharp,
toxic mushrooms sturdy enough
to withstand a wyvern's weight.

forms.name: Roguish Deathcap
forms.text:
The Wyvern's Perch's final
form. Its deadly poison works
on wyverns of all sizes.

forms.name: Lordly Deathcap
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wyvern's Perch</COL>.

forms.name: Cheese Mixer
forms.text:
The product of one chef's
dream to bring cheese to the
frontlines of food and battle.

forms.name: Cheese Jumbler
forms.text:
Don't mix anything other than
cheese with the Cheese Mixer's
final form...or else!

forms.name: Cheese Combinator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cheese Mixer</COL>.

forms.name: El Dora Blade
forms.text:
A decorative sword made of
treasure discovered by the
Meownster Hunters.

forms.name: Lost Blade
forms.text:
The El Dora Blade's final
form. Forever sharp as it
is shiny with jewels.

forms.name: Lost Lemuria
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>El Dora Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Hanayako Yohino
forms.text:
A Great Sword of a refined,
educated samurai. These
petals blossom with death.

forms.name: Akanesasu
forms.text:
The Hanayako Yohino's final
form. Shines pale in the dawn
like the lives it snatches.

forms.name: Akanesasu Divider
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hanayako Yohino</COL>.

forms.name: Verdant Wing
forms.text:
A Great Sword modeled off
Astalos wings. Thunder sounds
with every slash.

forms.name: Astalos Elecblade
forms.text:
The Verdant Wing's final
form shakes up the world
with its fierce thunder.

forms.name: Astalos Arcblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Verdant Wing</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Slicer
forms.text:
A Great Sword theorized to
have once been used by the
mountain god's protectors.

forms.name: Colossus's Slicer
forms.text:
The Giant's Slicer's
final form. Used by the most
unfeeling of protectors.

forms.name: Behemoth's Slicer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Slicer</COL>.

forms.name: Scorching Blazer
forms.text:
A Great Sword based on the
Glavenus's tail. Slices up
prey like nothing else.

forms.name: Glavenus Array
forms.text:
When the Scorching Blazer's
final form burns a path through
battle, only ash remains.

forms.name: Glavenus Arranova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scorching Blazer</COL>.

forms.name: Schattenstolz
forms.text:
A jet black, evil blade made
during the Magala eclipse.
Inflicts deathly banishment.

forms.name: Düsterstolz
forms.text:
The Schattenstolz's final
form. The beacon that leads
demons into hell's depths.

forms.name: Verhängnisstolz
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Schattenstolz</COL>.

forms.name: L'Apothéose
forms.text:
A blade like a prism that
transforms sunlight into a
mesmerizing spell.

forms.name: L'Éclat
forms.text:
Nothing can resist walking
toward the light of
L'Apothéose's final form.

forms.name: L'Origine
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>L'Apothéose</COL>.

forms.name: Kirin Thundersword
forms.text:
Attacking with this sword
sends lightning surging
through your prey's body.

forms.name: King Thundersword
forms.text:
The Kirin Thundersword's
final form. An immaculate
blade from ancient times.

forms.name: Emperor Thundersword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kirin Thundersword</COL>.

forms.name: Grand Shamshir
forms.text:
An eerie Chameleos blade used
for hunting prey. Its swings leave
a deadly miasma in their wake.

forms.name: Foreboding Shamshir
forms.text:
The Grand Shamshir's final
form. The last thing prey
sees past a mist of poison.

forms.name: Dreaded Shamshir
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grand Shamshir</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Great Sword
forms.text:
A hideous Great Sword wielded
by those who would heed the
Nakarkos's fearsome roars.

forms.name: Infernal Great Sword
forms.text:
The Skeletal Great Sword's
final sword blights the
righteous with fear.

forms.name: Infernal Corleonis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Great Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Astral Leo
forms.text:
The executor of celestial
will from the heavens,
binding the stars together.

forms.name: Dreadful Leo
forms.text:
The Astral Leo's final form.
A celestial oracle sent to
brutally smite the wicked.

forms.name: Baleful Star Leo
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astral Leo</COL>.

forms.name: Aloe Blade
forms.text:
A blade made of plants that
grow in monster nests. The
gel is medicinal, too.

forms.name: Aloe Stenyo
forms.text:
Each cut feels soothing due
to the gel oozing from the
Aloe Blade's final form.

forms.name: Aloe Legante
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aloe Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Black Belt Blade
forms.text:
A reward bestowed only to
those who have surmounted
numerous arena fights.

forms.name: Shihan Blade
forms.text:
The Black Belt Blade's final
form. Filled with the memories
of countless bloody bouts.

forms.name: Grandmaster Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Belt Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Black Blade
forms.text:
Great Sword with a dark
power. The despair within
eats at its user.

forms.name: Chrono Blade
forms.text:
The Black Blade's final
form. Cursed to hunt living
beings to the ends of time.

forms.name: Fatalis Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Cat's Soul
forms.text:
A sword with a face. Said to
hold the soul of a Felyne
who defended its master.

forms.name: Cat's Curse
forms.text:
The final form of the Cat's
Soul. Said to be cursed by a
Felvine-less Felyne.

forms.name: Cat's King
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cat's Soul</COL>.

forms.name: Demon Rod
forms.text:
Wrapped in thunderous Rajang
fur, this weapon can easily
crush anything it touches.

forms.name: Great Demon Rod
forms.text:
The Demon Rod's final form
spews thunder that hits
hard and shakes the sky.

forms.name: Great Demon Hot Rod
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demon Rod</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Club
forms.text:
A golden mass of Rajang menace.
One swing summons thunderclouds
that bring ruin to the area.

forms.name: Demonlord Goldrod
forms.text:
The Demonlord Club's final
form looses thunder as though
it were divine punishment.

forms.name: Demonlord Cruncher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Club</COL>.

forms.name: Berserker Sword
forms.text:
An immensely heavy blade that
channels a Deviljho's power,
reducing foes to splinters.

forms.name: Anguish
forms.text:
The Berserker Sword's final
form. Ever starved for blood,
it hunts for new prey.

forms.name: Nero's Anguish
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Berserker Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Consummate Blade
forms.text:
The essence of savage might in
blade form. Ever hungry, it
feeds with no sign of satiation.

forms.name: Doomedge "Hrunting"
forms.text:
The Consummate Blade's final
form. The starving dragon has
come bearing vengeance.

forms.name: Guiltedge "Tyrfing"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Consummate Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Autumn Umbrella
forms.text:
It's a Great Sword AND an
umbrella! Honestly, what
more could you ask for!?

forms.name: Shearing Umbrella
forms.text:
The Autumn Umbrella's final
form, achieved out of a desire
for maximum convenience.

forms.name: Scarlet Parasol
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Autumn Umbrella</COL>.

forms.name: Expert Blade
forms.text:
A Great Sword authorized only
for master hunters. Engraved
with the words, "Great job!"

forms.name: Warrior's Blade
forms.text:
The Expert Blade's final
form. Even as a master, you
still have room to grow.

forms.name: Unrivaled Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Expert Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Research Great Sword
forms.text:
A Sword intended for the guard
of the Soaratorium. Also functions
as a meticulous compass.

forms.name: Discovery Great Sword
forms.text:
The Research Great Sword's final
form. It offers direction to those
who follow the pen and sword.

forms.name: Authority Viator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Great Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Fox Blade
forms.text:
A special Famitsu weapon. It
holds the spirit of a golden
fox, striding towards tomorrow.

forms.name: Discovery Corps Blade
forms.text:
The Fox Blade's final form.
Its gleam points the way
to a bright future.

forms.name: Pathfinder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fox Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Captain Blade J
forms.text:
Sealed with the power of the
master of the seas. The left
eye flashes with ambition.

forms.name: Captain Buster J
forms.text:
The Captain Blade J's final
form. The epic ambition and
spirit of a pirate rest within.

forms.name: Captain Caliber J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Captain Blade J</COL>.

forms.name: Amol Saiqa
forms.text:
A giant sword imbued with
supernatural energy. Its heat
can burn through solid steel.

forms.name: Amol Saiqa X
forms.text:
Amol Saiqa's final form.
The mystical power in its ebon
blade has been honed to the max.

forms.name: Amol Saiqa XX
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Amol Saiqa</COL>.

forms.name: Chivalry
forms.text:
A Great Sword imbued with the
spirit of a chivalrous gambler.
Its scars are a source of pride.

forms.name: Indignant Scar
forms.text:
Chivalry's final form. Imbued
with the kind spirit of Japan's
most famous brawler.

forms.name: Noble Scar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chivalry</COL>.

forms.name: G Blade
forms.text:
The "G" burns brightly on
this new Great Sword. Heavy
for aggressive chopping.

forms.name: GX Blade
forms.text:
The G Blade's final form.
The latest technology creates
a cutting-edge cutting edge.

forms.name: GXX Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>G Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Broadsword
forms.text:
Great Sword with the power of the
black god. It's said the bearer
is fated to rule the world.

forms.name: Akantor Kingsword
forms.text:
The Akantor Broadsword's
final form grants the wielder
power over fate itself.

forms.name: Akantor Godsword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Broadsword</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Destructor
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white
god's ninth power: its fury.
Powerful enough to end the world.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skycleaver
forms.text:
The rage of the Ukanlos
Destructor's final form rips
apart both heaven and earth.

forms.name: Ukanlos Worldrender
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Destructor</COL>.

forms.name: Roilcloud Sword
forms.text:
The manifestation of gods
who rule over all life behind
the veil of clouds.

forms.name: Heavenly Sunshine
forms.text:
The Roilcloud Sword's final
form. Behind those gray skies,
the gods work to save all.

forms.name: Astralis Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Roilcloud Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Great Sword
forms.text:
An unsettling blade with a
sinister light and the power
to steal creatures' souls.

forms.name: Alatreon Revolution
forms.text:
The Alatreon Great Sword's
final form. One who chooses
this chooses a dragon's life.

forms.name: Altheos Evolutia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Great Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Great Sword
forms.text:
The Great Sword of the Argent
Comet. Like a brilliant star, it tears
through the darkness.

forms.name: Dragonstar Hal
Magnastar Emdon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Great Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Blade
forms.text:
A Soaratorium Great Sword for
hunters breaking new ground.
Marvellous Sharpness and power.

forms.name: Sage Blade
forms.text:
The Elder Blade's final form.
Strong enough to cleave the
earth in twain.

forms.name: Philosopher Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Palette Knife
forms.text:
Here's something new for your
tastebuds! Let the master chef
tickle your tongue with delight!

forms.name: Leveler
forms.text:
The Palette Knife's final form has
new thrills in store! Open your
mind to this taste sensation!

forms.name: Doughminator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Palette Knife</COL>.

forms.name: Viking Hornsword
forms.text:
A blade crafted from a giant
horn, Ceadeus's pride. It
shines with foes' blood.

forms.name: Ancharius Sword
forms.text:
The Viking Hornsword's final form.
A sea god's soul slumbers within,
causing it to glow dully.

forms.name: Excalius Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Viking Hornsword</COL>.

forms.name: Drifter's Sword
forms.text:
A sword for a mindless
warrior who does nothing
but eat, sleep, and fight!

forms.name: Satsuma Sword
forms.text:
The final form of the
Drifter's Sword. Heads
are gonna roll!

forms.name: Toyohisa Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of
the <COL FF0000FF>Drifter's Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Garo Sword
forms.text:
A Sword that harbors the
souls of bygone heroes. The
last stand against the dark.

forms.name: True Garo Sword
forms.text:
An extension of the bearer,
the Garo Sword's final form
can cut dark forces asunder.

forms.name: Legendary Garo Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Garo Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Licht/Ombre
forms.text:
A wicked blade whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Düster/Éclat
forms.text:
The Licht/Ombre's final form.
Shows its true potential only to
those who would shatter the dark.

forms.name: Anfang/Fin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Licht/Ombre</COL>.

forms.name: Dragonslayer
forms.text:
This legendary blade has been the
demise of many dragons. Dragon
hide splits like silk beneath it.

forms.name: Dragon Massacre
forms.text:
The Dragonslayer's final form.
The wielder shall bring dragon
souls under their rule.

forms.name: Eternal Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragonslayer</COL>.

forms.name: Gold Great Sword
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of the darkness
that beckons the souls of the dead.

forms.name: Inscribed Anubis
forms.text:
The Gold Great Sword's final form.
It belonged to a god of the world
beyond the darkness outside.

forms.name: Neb-Ta-Djeser
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gold Great Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Fireblade
forms.text:
The Sword of red fury. This crimson
blade's attacks bestow an
exquisite despair on its victims.

forms.name: Fatalis State
forms.text:
The Fatalis Fireblade's final form
sows explosive furies of
destruction in its wake.

forms.name: Fatalis Vulcania
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Fireblade</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Ancestor
forms.text:
This shining blade illuminates
the darkness that lies deep
in man's soul.

forms.name: Fatalis Ancient
forms.text:
The Fatalis Ancestor's final form.
The light unleashed by this blade
brings light even to abyssal depths.

forms.name: Fatalis Legacy
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Ancestor</COL>.

forms.name: Eostoclad
forms.text:
A Great Sword made of
Snowbaron parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Principality
forms.text:
The Eostoclad's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Snowbaron Lagombi.

forms.name: Principality Blizzard
forms.text:
